Large-Format Cups (30-32oz): A Sourcing Guide for Smoothies & Shareables

When to Use Large-Format Cups

Large-format cups (30oz and 32oz) are ideal for shareable smoothies, promotional "super-size" offers, and high-value bubble tea menus. These jumbo sizes require specific wall thickness and base support to handle the heavier liquid weight without buckling during service or transport.

Verified 107mm PET Specifications

The specifications below are for the 107mm caliber PET series, used for the largest cold drink servings in our catalog.

107-10701107 mm32 oz178 mm20 g600 pcs

Carton Planning for Jumbo Cups

Due to their height and width, 30-32oz cups are packed 600 pieces per carton, compared to the standard 1,000 pieces for standard sizes. This lower packing density affects your container loading and freight cost per unit. Factor this difference into your logistics planning when introducing a large-format cup range.

Article FAQs

What is the caliber of the 32oz cup?

The 32oz large-format PET cup has a 107mm caliber and is 178mm tall. It weighs 20g for improved rigidity at this height.

Which lids fit the large cups?

107mm is a large, specialty caliber. Match it with 107mm flat or dome lids. Confirm the specific lid model with us to ensure a leak-proof seal.

Why is the carton count only 600 pcs?

Jumbo cups take more volume per piece. To keep shipping cartons to a manageable size, we pack 600 pieces per box. Standard 16/22oz cups typically ship in 1,000-piece cartons.
